title: Vagaja2023: Motor-imagery EEG during embodiment-primed MI-BCI training in VR
description: This dataset contains motor-imagery EEG recorded from 26 healthy volunteers performing cued left- versus right-hand motor imagery during MI-BCI training in immersive virtual reality. A between-subject design compared an embodiment-primed (virtual hand illusion) group with a non-embodied control group, each completing one run of 40 trials. Recordings also include bipolar EMG, skin temperature and accelerometry, and are re-released in BIDS format via MOABB.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a Brain Products LiveAmp 32 using active Ag/AgCl actiCAP electrodes (32 EEG channels, 2 EMG, 4 misc) at 500 Hz in BrainVision Recorder. Participants performed cue-based left/right-hand motor imagery with a 10 s imagery/feedback window and visual feedback in a virtual-reality environment, with 20 trials per class in a single lab session.
